views.definition:
SELECT provider,
    is_active,
    tenant_id,
        CASE
            WHEN (provider = 'stripe'::text) THEN (config ->> 'publishable_key'::text)
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS publishable_key,
        CASE
            WHEN (provider = 'stripe'::text) THEN (config ->> 'checkout_mode'::text)
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS checkout_mode
   FROM integrations_checkout_providers;
views.name: checkout_providers_public
